summary: Operational backend for the `beep graphiti` subcommands: it validates/derives env-backed config, shells out to docker/systemctl/curl/sh, and orchestrates five use-cases (ensureGraphitiProxy, restoreGraphitiStack, verifyGraphitiStack, recoverGraphitiStack, installGraphitiProxyService) plus pure ForTesting decision helpers consumed by test/graphiti-proxy-security.test.ts via the src/test/Graphiti.test-kit.ts star-export facade.

concerns.name: Validated schemas and config models
concerns.description: Schema-first models: the UpstreamMcpUrl filtered string (systemd-injection guard with CONTROL_CHARACTER_PATTERN), and three S.Class config records (ProxyEnsureConfig private, GraphitiRestoreConfig and ProxyServiceConfig exported), plus the option/environment type aliases.

concerns.name: Env-var/config resolution
concerns.description: Sync env lookup helpers (Effect.runSync(Config.option) inside configStringOptionSync) with typed fallbacks, DEFAULT_GRAPHITI_* constants, and three builder functions that assemble the config records from ~20 env vars. Includes the pure resolveGraphitiStackDirForTesting precedence helper.

concerns.name: Child-process execution primitives
concerns.description: Generic step runners over QualityTaskStep (imported cross-group from commands/Quality/Tasks.js): captured, successful-or-fail, optional, and inherited-stdio variants, plus commandText/shellQuote and curl-based checkProxyHealthUrl, requireExistingPath, requireOutputContains assertions.

concerns.name: Docker container health polling
concerns.description: docker availability/inspect wrappers and Clock-deadline polling loops (5s/1s sleeps) for the falkor/browser/graphiti containers and the proxy health endpoint.

concerns.name: Stack restore/verify orchestration
concerns.description: docker-compose step builders, preflight filesystem/compose assertions, Falkor redis-cli smoke checks, an embedded multi-line sh+curl+awk MCP session probe script, timestamped data backup, and the exported restoreGraphitiStack/verifyGraphitiStack use-cases.

concerns.name: systemd user-service management
concerns.description: Renders the beep-graphiti-proxy.service unit text (with %-escaping and the UpstreamMcpUrl injection guard), detects unit drift, checks/starts the unit via systemctl, and installs/enables it (installGraphitiProxyService, guarded by guardLiteralArg and S.decodeUnknownEffect(UpstreamMcpUrl)).

concerns.name: Proxy ensure/recover lifecycle
concerns.description: PID-file liveness (process.kill(pid,0)), detached setsid/nohup launch via generated sh script, log tailing, container-restart recovery with the pure shouldRecoverGraphitiStackForTesting predicate, and the exported ensureGraphitiProxy/recoverGraphitiStack deadline loops.

concerns.name: Console/plan rendering
concerns.description: Dry-run plan line rendering and pervasive tagged Console.log/Console.error progress lines ([graphiti-restore]/[graphiti-recover]/[graphiti-proxy:ensure] prefixes) interleaved into every orchestration function.

proposedSplit.contents: UpstreamMcpUrl (with CONTROL_CHARACTER_PATTERN / hasControlCharacters / isSafeUpstreamMcpUrl), ProxyEnsureConfig, GraphitiRestoreConfig, ProxyServiceConfig, and the GraphitiRestoreOptions / GraphitiProxyServiceInstallOptions / GraphitiProxyOpsEnvironment types. Pure schema module with no process or fs imports; ProxyServices.ts health-payload schemas could later join it.

Env/config-provider resolution: DEFAULT_GRAPHITI_* constants, envValue/intEnvValue/booleanEnvValue/homeDirectory (or reuse configStringOptionSync from Quality/internal/Config.ts), proxyEnsureConfig, proxyServiceConfig, graphitiRestoreConfig, containerName, proxyPortFromUrl, resolveGraphitiStackDirForTesting. Keep builders as functions so env is read at call time, not import time. Existing internal/ProxyConfig.ts (GraphitiProxyConfig loader) is a candidate to merge here later.

Process primitives shared by all other new modules: commandText, shellQuote, collectStepOutput, collectSuccessfulOutput, collectOptionalOutput, runInheritedStep, checkProxyHealthUrl/checkProxyHealth, requireExistingPath, requireOutputContains, dockerAvailable, dockerRequired. Leaf module so ProxyEnsure and StackRestore can both depend on it without cycles.

containerExists, containerHealth, waitForHealthyContainers, restoreContainerHealthStates, waitForRestoreContainers, requireRestoreContainersHealthy, waitForRestoreProxyHealthy. Depends only on StepExec + schemas.

systemd unit machinery: escapeSystemdEnvironmentValue, renderServiceUnit + renderProxyServiceUnitForTesting, shouldInstallProxyServiceForTesting, readProxyServiceUnit, proxyServiceIsActive, ensureProxyServiceForRestore, installGraphitiProxyService. The renderServiceUnit/renderRestorePlan pair could instead earn Graphiti.render.ts, but they are private machinery tested through the test kit, so internal/ is the lower-risk home.

composeArgs/composeStep, backupTimestamp + backupDirectoryNameFromEpochMillisForTesting, preflightGraphitiStack, verifyFalkor, verifyProxy, runMcpSessionProbe, backupGraphitiData, renderRestorePlan, restoreGraphitiStack, verifyGraphitiStack. Depends on StepExec, ContainerHealth, ProxyServiceInstall (ensureProxyServiceForRestore), config, schemas.

readLivePid, startProxyDetached, tailLog, recoverGraphitiStackInternal, shouldRecoverGraphitiStackForTesting, ensureGraphitiProxy, recoverGraphitiStack. Depends on StepExec, ContainerHealth, config, schemas; no dependency on StackRestore.

Optional follow-up to reach canonical topology: a GraphitiStackOps Context.Service exposing ensure/restore/verify/recover/install (wrapping the internal modules) with a default live layer, so Graphiti.command.ts consumes a service contract instead of deep internal imports. Defer if scope must stay mechanical.

sharedCandidates.description: Generic QualityTaskStep runners (captured, must-succeed, best-effort, inherited-stdio). Near-identical copies already exist in Quality/Tasks.ts, Quality/Quality.command.ts, Quality/FallowQuality.command.ts, Quality/internal/PackageVerify.ts, and Docgen/internal/Local.ts — this is a five-way duplication that deserves one shared module (e.g. src/internal/StepExec.ts next to QualityTaskStep).

Exact duplicate of the export already in src/commands/Quality/internal/Config.ts (same name, same body). Delete the ProxyOps copy and import the existing one, or promote to a shared config-helpers module.
General env-with-fallback readers (string, positive-int, tri-state boolean) with no Graphiti coupling; natural companions to Quality/internal/Config.ts.

POSIX single-quote escaping duplicating shellQuote already exported from @beep/repo-ai-metrics (packages/tooling/library/ai-metrics/src/shell.ts) with an equivalent but differently-written body. Converge on one implementation, likely in @beep/repo-utils.

Line-injection guard for values interpolated into line-oriented files (systemd units). AIMetrics renders systemd timer plans (renderAiMetricsForwarderTimerPlan) and would benefit from the same fail-closed check.
curl-based bounded health probe for an arbitrary URL; only weakly Graphiti-specific and reusable by any command that waits on a local HTTP service.

risks: Test-kit facade breakage: src/test/Graphiti.test-kit.ts does `export * from "@beep/repo-cli/commands/Graphiti/internal/ProxyOps"` and test/graphiti-proxy-security.test.ts imports GraphitiRestoreConfig, ProxyServiceConfig, and all five *ForTesting helpers through @beep/repo-cli/test/Graphiti — every new module holding those symbols must be added to the test-kit star-exports (or a ProxyOps barrel kept) or the vitest suite fails to compile.

Duplicate-export collisions: ProxyOps re-exports GraphitiProxyOpsError from ../Graphiti.errors.js while the test kit also star-exports commands/Graphiti/index (which exports Graphiti.errors); splitting into several modules that each re-export the error, or that share helper names (e.g. collectStepOutput vs Quality/Tasks.ts's export), can produce ambiguous `export *` conflicts in the test kit.

Import-time env freezing: configStringOptionSync uses Effect.runSync at call time and all config builders are lazy functions; converting proxyEnsureConfig/graphitiRestoreConfig results into module-level schema constants during the split would freeze env vars at import time and break tests that mutate GRAPHITI_* env between cases.

Cycle hazard in the dependency seams: ensureProxyServiceForRestore (restore path) calls installGraphitiProxyService (systemd module), and both the ensure loop and restore waits call checkProxyHealthUrl — StepExec and ProxyServiceInstall must stay leaf-ward of StackRestore/ProxyEnsure or the split introduces import cycles.

Docgen @example paths: many JSDoc examples reference the deep path @beep/repo-cli/commands/Graphiti/internal/ProxyOps (and one references @beep/repo-cli/test/Graphiti); moved symbols need their examples repointed or `bun run docgen` example compilation fails.

Cross-group coupling: QualityTaskStep is imported from ../../Quality/Tasks.js; extracting a shared StepExec module should decide QualityTaskStep's home first, otherwise the split deepens Graphiti->Quality coupling and complicates the planned Quality-side dedup.

summary: Single 1090-line internal module implementing the entire Graphiti MCP proxy data plane: schema/literal domains, HTTP error/health response builders, three Context.Service contracts, bounded request-body reading with fast-lane MCP classification, docker-based dependency health probing, upstream HTTP forwarding, and a semaphore-backed queue/backpressure engine. Consumed by ProxyRuntime.ts (server wiring) and re-exported for tests via src/test/Graphiti.test-kit.ts.

concerns.name: Schema and literal domain models
concerns.description: LiteralKit unions (health states, error kinds, lanes, fast MCP method/tool allowlists with S.is guards), S.Class payloads (health snapshot, queue stats, health/error payloads, JSON-RPC envelope subset), the URLSearchParams-to-UrlParams SchemaTransformation, and derived decoders.

concerns.name: HTTP response rendering and error mapping
concerns.description: Builders for structured JSON error/health HttpServerResponses (dual-signature), Match-based HttpClientError-reason-to-response mapping, and x-graphiti-proxy-* header stamping.

concerns.name: Service contracts (shapes + Context.Service tags)
concerns.description: Three service shapes and their Context.Service tags plus supporting types (RequestTargetRejection, BufferedProxyRequest). Pure contract, no implementation.

concerns.name: Bounded body read + fast-lane classification
concerns.description: Security-sensitive bounded streaming body read (Content-Length fail-closed, takeUntil cap, chunk concat) and pure JSON-RPC fast-lane detection; both explicitly exported for tests.

concerns.name: Dependency health probing (process exec) + TTL-cached service impl
concerns.description: Bun.spawnSync docker inspect per container, health-string parsing, and the Ref-cached makeGraphitiDependencyHealthService factory honoring dependencyHealthTtlMs.

concerns.name: Upstream forwarder service impl
concerns.description: Request-target validation (absolute-form rejection, endpoint-subtree allowlist), header scrubbing, body re-attachment, timeout-wrapped HttpClient.execute, and streaming-aware slot settlement (settleForwardedResponse defers release to the SSE body finalizer).

concerns.name: Queue/backpressure service impl
concerns.description: Dropping Queue with forked worker pool, Semaphore-bounded concurrency shared by queued and fast lanes, active/processed/failed/rejected/peak counters, shutdown/drain protocol (acceptingRef, drainDeferred), and enqueue-time fail-closed target/body checks.

proposedSplit.contents: All LiteralKit unions and S.is guards, S.Class payload models (DependencyHealthDetails/Snapshot, ProxyQueueStats, ProxyHealthPayload, ProxyErrorPayload, GraphitiMcpToolCallParams, GraphitiMcpJsonRpcRequest), urlSearchParamsSchema and the derived decode helpers. Zero non-schema imports; lines 48-263 today.

proxyErrorResponse and proxyHealthResponse duals, ProxyErrorResponseOptions, matchHttpClientErrorToRes/mapHttpClientErrorToResponse, addProxyHeaders. Depends only on ProxySchemas (ProxyErrorPayload/ProxyHealthPayload/ProxyLane) and effect/unstable/http.

Keep the file as the contract module: the three service shapes, Context.Service tags, RequestTargetRejection and BufferedProxyRequest types, plus (transitional) re-exports of the moved test-facing symbols so the test-kit export * and JSDoc example imports stay valid. Keeping the tags here preserves the $I namespace string commands/Graphiti/internal/ProxyServices baked into service identities.

Bounded body read machinery (RequestBodyOutcome, parseContentLength, concatChunkedBody, readRequestBodyBytes + readRequestBodyBytesForTesting) and fast-lane classification (isFastMcpRequestEnvelope, isFastMcpRequestBody, utf8Decoder). Depends on ProxySchemas for the MCP envelope decoder and guards.

Docker container health probing (readContainerHealth via Bun.spawnSync, parseContainerHealth, unknownDependencySnapshot) and makeGraphitiDependencyHealthService with its TTL Ref cache. Depends on ProxySchemas + the GraphitiDependencyHealthService tag.

Path/target validation helpers (normalizeEndpointPath, isAllowedEndpointPath, isAbsoluteRequestTarget, absoluteRequestTargetPattern), settleForwardedResponse, and makeGraphitiProxyForwarderService. Depends on ProxySchemas (urlSearchParams decoder), ProxyResponses, and the forwarder tag.

makeGraphitiProxyQueueService in full: queue/worker pool, forwardWithSlot slot accounting, drain protocol, enqueue with fail-closed checks, stats snapshot. Depends on ProxyBody, ProxyResponses, ProxySchemas (ProxyQueueStats), and the forwarder/queue tags.

sharedCandidates.description: Container health probing is duplicated inside the Graphiti group itself: internal/ProxyOps.ts:580-597 reimplements the identical docker inspect call via ChildProcessSpawner while this file uses Bun.spawnSync. Consolidating on one ChildProcessSpawner-based helper removes the direct Bun.spawnSync process exec from this file.
alsoUsefulFor: Quality (already shells docker for osv-scan/semgrep steps)
any future group probing dockerized deps

sharedCandidates.description: Fully generic bridge between the WHATWG URLSearchParams and effect UrlParams; nothing Graphiti-specific. Candidate for @beep/schema or a shared CLI http util.

sharedCandidates.helper: readRequestBodyBytes (bounded streaming body read with Content-Length fail-closed)
sharedCandidates.description: Generic HTTP-server hardening utility parameterized only by maxBodyBytes; nothing references Graphiti. Only the Graphiti proxy hosts an HTTP server today, so promotion is optional until a second server command exists.
alsoUsefulFor: any future CLI-hosted HTTP server or proxy command

sharedCandidates.description: Generic Match-based mapping of HttpClientError reasons to 5xx/4xx HttpServerResponses; only the ProxyErrorPayload body shape ties it to Graphiti. Extractable if a second proxy/gateway command appears.

risks: Lint focus allowlist hard-codes this exact path: packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/Lint.command.ts:40 lists internal/ProxyServices.ts in FOCUS_RUNTIME_FILES (alongside ProxyConfig/ProxyRuntime); new internal files must be added there or the runtime schema-first lint silently stops covering the moved code.

Test-kit facade: src/test/Graphiti.test-kit.ts does export * from '@beep/repo-cli/commands/Graphiti/internal/ProxyServices', and test/graphiti-proxy-security.test.ts imports isFastMcpRequestBody, makeGraphitiProxyForwarderService, readRequestBodyBytesForTesting via '@beep/repo-cli/test/Graphiti'; moved symbols need new export * lines (watch for duplicate-name collisions across star exports) or transitional re-exports from ProxyServices.ts.

Service identity strings: the Context.Service tags and every S.Class/annotation are keyed by $RepoCliId.create('commands/Graphiti/internal/ProxyServices'); moving tags/schemas to files with new $I namespaces changes their identity strings — keep the tags in ProxyServices.ts (proposed) or deliberately accept/verify the identifier churn (schema catalog is generated+tracked, so diffs will surface).

Definition-order coupling: matchHttpClientErrorToRes (line 281) references proxyErrorResponse declared later (line 310) via function-hoisting-tolerant const usage that only works because both live in one module; the split must place proxyErrorResponse before/with the matcher in ProxyResponses.ts, and the schemas->responses->tags->impls import DAG must stay acyclic.

ProxyRuntime.ts imports 9 symbols from ./ProxyServices.js (tags, factories, ProxyHealthPayload, proxyHealthResponse, DependencyHealthSnapshot type); all its import paths must be rewritten in the same change, and behavior around Layer.provideMerge ordering must remain untouched.

Docgen/JSDoc: the isFastMcpRequestBody @example imports the deep path '@beep/repo-cli/commands/Graphiti/internal/ProxyServices'; if the symbol moves without a re-export, docgen example compilation breaks. Dual-signature exports (proxyErrorResponse, proxyHealthResponse, makeGraphitiProxyQueueService) must keep their exact overload signatures for type-level consumers.
